business_summary: Shenzhen Minkave Technology Co., Ltd. engages in landscape lighting engineering business in China. It is involved in the design and construction of lighting projects; and research, development, production, and sales of related lighting products. The company's lighting products include LED wall washers, LED point lights, LED linear lights, LED guardrail lights, floodlights, tree lights, corrugated lights, window sill lights, and other special artistic lighting fixtures. Its products are used in commercial lighting, municipal road lighting, landscape decorative lighting, and agricultural lighting, as well as for the construction of self-owned lighting projects. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Minkave City Lighting Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Minkave Technology Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Minkave Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
